description.fun: Mew is said to carry the DNA of every Pokémon, so many scientists believe it's the ancestor of them all. It can turn invisible at will, which is why so few have seen it, but it will show itself to someone pure of heart who truly wants to meet it. It almost didn't exist: designer Shigeki Morimoto slipped it into Red and Green at the last minute, using about 300 bytes of spare space, after being told not to touch the finished games.
description.guide: A small, pink, cat-like Psychic Mythical Pokémon said to carry the DNA of every Pokémon, and thought by many scientists to be their common ancestor. It is very rarely seen because it can make itself invisible. Mewtwo was created from its DNA.
description.tagline: The secret ancestor of every Pokémon
